title: 第九十四章  女帝的欣赏
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此时，赵知武的心里慌得一批。

这要是露馅了，可就玩大了啊！

不过，赵知武转念一想，顾淮那家伙神机妙算，连朝堂上的局势都能算得一清二楚，这个舆论的问题，他肯定也有办法。

想到这，他故意露出一副为难而深思的神色，对着女帝深深一揖。

“陛下，此问直指要害，微臣佩服。”

“国内舆论之事，关系到我大楚的江山社稷，微臣确实不敢轻慢。”

“这件事，微臣脑子里已经有了一些头绪，但事关重大，微臣还需要回去仔细琢磨一下，将每一个细节都考虑周全。”

说到这里，赵知武拍了拍胸膛，脸上露出一抹洒脱而自信的笑容。

“不过，陛下尽管放心，微臣向您保证，最多两天，微臣定会将这件事办得漂漂亮亮的，绝不让陛下为难！”

上官绡看着赵知武那胸有成竹的模样，心中的阴霾顿时消散了大半。

她不仅没有因为赵知武的迟疑而生气，反而诧异赵知武的稳重！

这舆论之事，可不是儿戏，若是他信口开河，只为说些好话让自己开心，那自己反而要重新审视他了。

可是现在，赵知武不骄不躁。

这，便让她内心更加满意了！

“好！”

上官绡长笑一声，神色间满是欣慰。

“朝堂之上，皆是只知争吵之辈，难得赵爱卿能为朕分忧。”

“大楚能得赵爱卿这样的良臣，朕心甚慰。”

上官绡转过头，对身旁的女官吩咐道。

“来人，赏赵知武黄金百两，玉如意一对。”

“臣，谢陛下隆恩！”

赵知武连忙跪倒谢恩。

上官绡微微颔首，神色变得严肃起来。

“赵爱卿，这两日你便留在府中好好琢磨此事。”

“过些日子，李老将军便会从西北班师回朝。”

“届时，朕要你亲自去与李将军商谈撤出河朔平原的具体事宜，你可明白？”

赵知武心中一凛，连忙拱手应道。

“微臣领旨，定不负陛下重托！”

交代完这些，上官绡挥了挥手，示意他离开。

赵知武再次行礼，这才离开了御书房。

上官绡靠在龙椅上，看着赵知武离去的背影，眼神有些飘忽，感慨良久。

At this time, Zhao Zhiwu felt panicked.

If this is exposed, it will be a big deal!

However, Zhao Zhiwu then thought about it. That guy Gu Huai was so clever that he could even calculate the situation in the court clearly. He must have a way to deal with this issue of public opinion.

Thinking of this, he deliberately showed a troubled and thoughtful look, and bowed deeply to the empress.

"Your Majesty, this question goes straight to the point. I admire you."

"Domestic public opinion matters are related to our country, the state of Chu, and I really don't dare to treat it lightly."

"Weichen already has some clues about this matter, but it is of great importance. Weichen needs to go back and think about it carefully and consider every detail."

Having said this, Zhao Zhiwu patted his chest, with a free and confident smile on his face.

"However, your Majesty, please rest assured. Wei Chen assures you that within two days at most, Wei Chen will handle this matter beautifully and will never embarrass your Majesty!"

Shangguan Xiao looked at Zhao Zhiwu's confident look, and most of the haze in his heart suddenly dissipated.

Not only was she not angry because of Zhao Zhiwu's hesitation, but she was surprised by Zhao Zhiwu's stability!

This matter of public opinion is not a child's play. If he talks freely just to say good things to make himself happy, then he will have to re-examine him.

But now, Zhao Zhiwu is neither arrogant nor impatient.

This made her even more satisfied!

"Okay!"

Shangguan Xiao gave a long laugh, his expression full of relief.

"The people in the court are all people who only know how to quarrel. It's rare that Zhao Aiqing can share my worries."

"I am very pleased that Chu has such a good minister as Zhao Aiqing."

Shangguan Xiao turned his head and gave instructions to the female officer beside him.

"Come here, I will reward Zhao Zhiwu with a hundred taels of gold and a pair of Ruyi jade."

"My lord, thank you for your kindness!"

Zhao Zhiwu quickly knelt down to thank him.

Shangguan Xiao nodded slightly and his expression became serious.

"Zhao Aiqing, you will stay in the house for the next two days and think about this matter carefully."

"In a few days, General Li will return to the DPRK from the northwest."

"At that time, I want you to personally discuss with General Li the specific matters of withdrawing from the Heshuo Plain. Do you understand?"

Zhao Zhiwu felt a chill in his heart and quickly responded with his hands raised.

"We will live up to your majesty's great trust if we accept the edict!"

After explaining this, Shangguan Xiao waved his hand to signal him to leave.

Zhao Zhiwu saluted again and then left the imperial study.

Shangguan Xiao leaned on the dragon chair and looked at Zhao Zhiwu's leaving figure. His eyes were a little wandering and he sighed for a long time.
